Remove duplicates from a list using a set and explain why order changes.

Supplied answer
nums = [3, 1, 2, 3, 1]
print(set(nums)) # {1, 2, 3} -> duplicates gone, order lost
print(sorted(set(nums))) # [1, 2, 3] -> order fixed by sorting
Note: Sets do not remember insertion order, so sort if you need a fixed order.
